cog-familiar.desc: small friendly brass cog companion, 0.7 m, spinning cog ears and back cog

clockwork-rabbit.desc: hopping brass wind-up rabbit with a spinning key, 0.7 m with ears

brass-firefly.desc: tiny brass dragonfly with glowing abdomen (spawn many; wings buzz in every clip), 0.5 m span

moss-grazer.desc: huge gentle moss-backed quadruped with mushrooms and rocks on its back, 1.9 m tall, extra clip graze

scrap-goblin.desc: first easy enemy: hunched goblin with bucket helmet and rusty cleaver, 1.35 m

rust-beetle.desc: easy enemy: rust-plated six-legged beetle with horn and mandibles, 0.85 m long, flips on its back when it dies

wisp.head: Core
wisp.desc: easy enemy / ambient: drifting glowing wisp with orbiting motes, 0.9 m, shrinks away on death

training-dummy.desc: clockwork practice dummy on a geared base with target on its chest, 2.1 m, sways when hit

clockwork-sentinel.desc: first mini-boss: 3.5 m brass-and-steel automaton knight with a glowing core, hammer fist and shield, spinning back cog
